quality.title: Automatic checks before import
quality.description: CK checks directory and path safety, dependencies, block and generator consistency, licenses, compatibility, and content hashes. Deterministic errors block installation; risks remain as warnings. Full evidence is available under Installed → Quality report.
quality.notice: Local static checks do not represent CK endorsement, publisher signatures, or hardware verification.

import.projectRequired: CK block imports need a project for version migration. Open or create a project and import from its workspace. You can still browse installed libraries, get libraries online, and import Arduino source libraries here.
import.ckDescription: Select multiple CK block-library ZIPs, or a library.json at a package root. CK processes the queue one item at a time; a failure does not hide later items.
import.arduinoDescription: Select multiple Arduino source-library ZIPs. Recursive src/** and legacy root + utility/** layouts are supported. Each item shows path, structure, hash, or license rejection reasons.

passport.title: Block library evidence passport
passport.description: Shows each evidence stage for the current package and this device; no aggregate score is calculated.

passport.boundary: The passport summarizes evidence available on this device. Pending is not failure, and passing does not imply CK endorsement.

detail.qualityReportMissing: No verifiable CK quality report is available.
detail.wrongPackageKind: The quality report identifies this package as {{kind}}, not a block library.
detail.qualityPending: The quality report has not reached a pass or block decision.
detail.packageIdMismatch: The quality report is bound to {{reportPackageId}}, which does not match {{expectedPackageId}}.
detail.structureEvidenceMissing: The local report is readable but lacks {{missing}}, so it is not complete structure evidence.
detail.structureWarnings: The local gate passed with {{count}} warnings.
detail.structurePassed: Directory layout, entry points, dependency shape, and content identity passed the local gate.
detail.legacySchema: This package uses schema v{{version}}. It is searchable but does not provide the eight v2 machine-semantic sections.
detail.emptyManifest: The v2 manifest declares no blocks.
detail.semanticsComplete: All {{count}} blocks declare semantics, dependencies, output, hardware, generation, constraints, examples, and errors.
detail.semanticsIncomplete: {{complete}} of {{total}} blocks have complete semantics; missing: {{missing}}.
detail.runtimeEvidenceMissing: The backend marked this as a declarative runtime, but {{missing}} is missing. The passport does not treat it as verified.
detail.runtimePassed: The three declarative entry points and exact content hash were verified without executing third-party JavaScript.
detail.legacyDisabled: Legacy JavaScript is preserved but disabled. Migrate it to declarative entry points.
detail.runtimeQualityBlocked: Runtime quality validation failed. Raw cause: {{cause}}
detail.legacyTrustInsufficient: A legacy trust record is not sandbox evidence. CK 1.0 does not execute third-party JavaScript based on it.
detail.runtimeUnavailable: This package does not provide an activatable declarative block runtime.
detail.compileEvidenceMissing: No independent compile-only credential is stored for this package content hash, complete FQBN, and toolchain.
detail.deviceEvidenceMissing: No hardware execution evidence is stored for this board, configuration, and package content.
detail.compileAuthorDeclared: The author reports successful compilation on {{targets}} ({{count}} record(s), latest {{testedAt}}). This is not independent CK verification.
detail.deviceAuthorDeclared: The author reports hardware upload or runtime testing on {{targets}} ({{count}} record(s), latest {{testedAt}}). This is not independent CK verification.
